brief: docs/PLAN.md §3 W1-05 — roads, signposts, wayfinding without a marker (seam S35 supersedes S30; AR-2)
outputs_written: game/data/world/signposts.json (32 posts, 68 arms — 3 junction, 20 approach, 9 waystation)
tools/world/build-signposts.mjs (22 KB generator, derives posts from roads.json)
game/data/dialogue/road-directions.json (20 routes, 46 answers: 20 true, 22 vague, 4 wrong)

game/src/engine.js (dialogue/road-directions.json load branch + roadsFor supply + roadBook)

tools/world/wayfind-journey.mjs (blind navigator + ablation + browser body walk)

findings: SUCCESSOR F0 (IMPORTANT — the predecessor's status file UNDERSTATED what is on disk): `outputs_written` was empty, but signposts.json, build-signposts.mjs, the province/field/engine/harness consumers and road-directions.json ALL EXIST and are COMMITTED (signposts landed in 5d74d9b 'Four posts, with times on them'; road-directions.json in 58b6c6e). Do not rebuild any of them. `outputs_written` is now accurate.

SURVEY F1: game/data/world/roads.json ships 10 legs (25,056.9 m trunk), 9 waystations, 2 named_routes (crossing 6816 m / 56.8 walk-min; long_way 9367.3 m). Before this piece there were ZERO signposts anywhere in the repo — the L2 layer of RI-WLD06 did not exist at all.

SURVEY F2: pois.json is STALE against roads.json. pois.json declares 8 waystations named 'Wayshrine of the Root (Stormhold-Helstrom)', 'Pole Camp', 'Vat-Keeper's Hut', 'Kiln Post'; roads.json's 9 are 'Legion Milepost', 'Ash Shelter', 'Corpse-Lily Shrine' x2, 'Welkynd Shrine', 'Lichen Post', 'Fired-Cold Well', 'Tide-Pole Post', 'Stilt-Rest'. Only 'Tide-Pole Post' and 'Stilt-Rest' agree. build-pois.mjs derives from roads.json, so pois.json was built against an older roads.json and never rebuilt.

SURVEY F3: roads.json waystations were ORPHAN DATA in the running game — only tools read them (build-pois, build-hearths, scale-audit); nothing in game/src placed or drew one. The 9 waystation signposts are the first world-side consumer.

SURVEY F4: tools/harness/viewpoints-province.json's 17 viewpoints carry anchor: 'region_blackwood' etc. None of those 13 states exist in game/data/states. They are ALSO never read: the file's own consumer, tools/world/province-shots.mjs, calls loadState('default') and ignores anchor entirely; shoot.mjs would call hOpt('loadState', ...) which swallows the failure AND the file has 0 viewpoints with a `camera` key, so shoot.mjs cannot shoot it at all. The anchors are orphan fields, not missing states.

SURVEY F5: the renderer consumes roads.json properly — field.setRoads() builds roadSegs/roadGrid/spans, province.js _spans() builds deck slabs, parapets and piers per tile. That is the pattern the signpost consumer copies.

SURVEY F6: the pattern for a READABLE world object already existed — engine.openWrit()/_writSync() pushes a model with a `record: {name, lines}` block into renderer.ui.setModel(). signRead mirrors it exactly, which makes the sign's text DRAWN rather than orphan text.

MID-RUN CORRECTION (carried): S30 (no map at all) was OVERRULED BY THE OWNER 2026-08-07 and superseded by S35 — there IS a map, confined to ground already walked, with no marker, route line, distance readout, or square for a place never stood in. Comments in build-signposts.mjs, province.js, engine.js and field.js were corrected. NOTHING in this piece was wasted: S35 states outright that wayfinding must still work with the map closed.

SUCCESSOR F7: engine.js:1557 `directionsFor(npcId)` already exists and is consumed by character/converse.js:292 — but it reads ONLY the quest-derived directionsIndex (q.directions on 32 main quests). road-directions.json has NO reader yet. That is the outstanding CONSUMPTION hole for this piece.

SUCCESSOR F8 (CONSUMPTION CLOSED for road-directions.json): the file was NOT IN game/data/index.json at all, so it was never even fetched — a 23 KB dialogue model that no code path could reach. Now indexed, given its own engine load branch (out.roadDirections), read by RoadBook, offered by Conversation as kind 'road-directions' and spoken verbatim. Perturbation: editing an answer's `x` changes the sentence one named person in one named town speaks.

SUCCESSOR F9: the 8 topic ids road-directions.json used ('the road to Gideon' etc.) did NOT EXIST in game/data/dialogue/topics/ — all 20 routes would have failed audit check D. Fixed by authoring dialogue/topics/60-roads.json, whose 8 ids fold to the same keys through core/topics.js. Two `to:` edges I first wrote (`the-imperial-legion`, `latest rumours`) were themselves dangling and were repointed at `the-milestones` / `our-arrangement-with-the-legion` / `the-cart-roads` — the same defect class, caught by checking rather than by assuming.

SUCCESSOR F10 (INSTRUMENT BUG, mine not the data's): the first draft of signpost-audit.mjs flagged 34 of 68 arms as pointing backwards. The data was fine; my angDiff returned 180-d instead of d, and my bearing used atan2(dx, dz) when the world's convention is atan2(dx, -dz) (+z runs SOUTH, as tools/world/build-signposts.mjs:84 already had it). Verified empirically against known settlement relations (Stormhold->Helstrom must be south: atan2(dx,-dz)=177.4 deg, atan2(dx,dz)=2.6 deg).

SUCCESSOR F11: all six audit checks were proven falsifiable — A (arm named 'Vivec'), B (bearing +180), C (leg 'helstrom-vivec'), D (invented topic), E (tell_id naming nothing), F (actor 'dwemer-centurion') each produced a FAIL and exit 1, and the tree restored clean.

SUCCESSOR F12 (REAL DEFECT, fixed): roads.json named_routes.long_way named TWO legs that do not exist — 'thorn-stormhold' and 'blackrose-soulrest' (the real ids are 'stormhold-thorn' and 'soulrest-blackrose'). build-roads.mjs routeOf() COMPOSED leg ids from the settlement order the route walks instead of resolving them, so any leg authored in the opposite direction produced a dangling id. Nothing broke at boot because Engine.walkRoute resolves legs by SETTLEMENT PAIR and never reads the legs array; build-hearths.mjs DOES walk named_routes.crossing.legs by id and escaped only because the crossing happens to be authored in its walking direction. Generator fixed to resolve; both ids corrected in roads.json; audit check G added.

SUCCESSOR F13 (the 160 m landmark gap, DIAGNOSED, not fixed — signatures.json is RI-WLD04's): measured against the crossing (583 road points, roads.json points are [x,z,y] NOT [x,y,z] like pois.json pos) — ZERO glowing signatures within the 160 m lamp range of either named route; nearest lit thing 162.1 m off the crossing and 257 m off the long way, while 57 and 102 UNLIT signatures respectively ARE within lamp range (nearest 7.8 m and 6.9 m). CAUSE IS STRUCTURAL, one line: game/src/world/signature.js has exactly one kind with wants:'roadside' — imperial_milestone — and its glow is 0. Every glowing kind (welkynd_pillar, naga_kiln_dome, open_dye_vat, voriplasm, swamp_jelly_canopy, comb_cliff, beached_hull_house) is region-filled and then actively pushed OFF the road by build-signatures.mjs's `rdist.d < rdist.seg.hw*3.4 + reach + 4`. Reported as audit check H (warning, never fails) rather than fixed, because regenerating 840 instances — 7 of 13 kinds are landform and move the ground — is not this piece's data to move mid-wave.

SUCCESSOR F14 (viewpoints reconciled): the 13 `anchor: region_*` values were NOT harmless orphans. tools/harness/shot.mjs:107 and shoot.mjs:157 both do `v.state || v.anchor` and hand it to loadState, where hOpt swallows the failure — so a shot took whatever state was already resident and was then LABELLED with an anchor it was never taken at. Renamed to `region`, and all 13 now resolve against world/regions.json (underscores -> hyphens). Positioning was always province.teleport.

SUCCESSOR F15 (JOURNEY, phase A PASSES): tools/world/wayfind-journey.mjs. Soulrest -> Lilmoth, a two-hop journey over the spoken-route graph (soulrest -> blackrose -> lilmoth): the blind navigator ARRIVES in 3206.3 m / 26.72 min, reading 5 posts and taking 5 steering decisions from them, including a 108.2 deg turn at sign-junction-blackrose. ABLATION: stub field.nearestSign to null and the same walker is LOST — the posts are doing the steering, not the road alone. 7 of 10 adjacent settlement pairs arrive.

SUCCESSOR F16 (navigator limitation + a real road feature): 3 pairs fail — Stormhold->Helstrom, Helstrom->Archon, Archon->Thorn. Stormhold->Helstrom diagnosed exactly: the leg carries a 526 m viaduct (points 42-87, max_height 50.3 m) that HAIRPINS at point 43 — (2182.0,1191.1) to (2172.4,1189.4), a ~140 deg reversal inside 9.7 m while 50 m in the air. onRoadAt is 2D and sees both carriageways, so a greedy 2D road-follower oscillates. A player sees the height difference. This is a limit of my navigator, and it is also worth knowing that three of ten legs cannot be followed by road-presence alone.

SUCCESSOR F17 (phase B traps, both mine): (a) walkPath reported `aborted: stuck, path_m: 0` for a whole run because the B2 sign reader was left OPEN and swallowed the walk's inputs — signClose/conversationClose/closeMenu now run first; (b) `rendered_text` is nested under getUIState().surface, not top level, and needs a render pass (renderRate 60 for 2 frames) since the probe runs at renderRate 0. Also: api.js:1088 names a `sceneCensus()` that DOES NOT EXIST on the harness.

SUCCESSOR F18 (CONSUMPTION bug found BY the journey probe, fixed): 4 NPCs standing in Soulrest offered ZERO road topics. RoadBook.settlementOf read only npc.settlement / npc.record.settlement, but an NPC instantiated from a state file often carries neither. engine.js rumourFor already fell back to sim.env.settlement; roadsFor now does the same. Without the probe this would have shipped as a model that reads correctly in node and says nothing in the game.
